artworks.label: Stained glass iris
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for lumen-mosaic. One graceful iris flower made from translucent tessellated stained glass, three broad warm amber/coral petals curving around an ivory center, slender deep-teal glass leaves, fine antique-brass leading along every mosaic shard. Exquisite premium artisan glass sculpture, realistic faceted transmission and soft warm light, teal/amber/coral/ivory palette. Entire flower compact and elegant, no bird, pomegranate, lantern, window or frame. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
